QUOTE: "`library/error.c` is generated, not hand-maintained. Both switch bodies are marked "Begin Auto-Generated Code", and `scripts/generate_errors.pl` is documented as "Generate error.c", taking an include dir, a data dir and an output file."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says error.c is generated by scripts/generate_errors.pl, but it does not name error.fmt as the template. It also says the generator reads a data-file input and that it could not verify the `.fmt` format.
